# Digital Insight AI

> Arabic practical guide for discovering and comparing AI tools for business, marketing, content creation, video production, and app development.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://digitalinsightai.com/): Main introduction and latest recommendations.
- [Start here](https://digitalinsightai.com/start.html): Guided entry point for new visitors.
- [AI tools directory](https://digitalinsightai.com/tools.html): Categorized AI tools and practical use cases.
- [Methodology](https://digitalinsightai.com/methodology.html): How tools and comparisons are evaluated.
- [About](https://digitalinsightai.com/about.html): Project purpose and author information.
- [Contact](https://digitalinsightai.com/contact.html): Contact and newsletter forms.
- [Privacy and affiliate disclosure](https://digitalinsightai.com/privacy-policy.html): Privacy terms and affiliate disclosure.
